#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs or builds the Callisto binary; callisto-action calls it directly by path.
set -euo pipefail

# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
# "git add -A").
CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"
DOCS_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/blob/main/docs/install-in-ci.md"

if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
  exit 1
fi

# Without an override, install the release this action's ref is pinned to (`callisto@X.Y.Z`), else the latest;
# a failed tag lookup fails the step, and a named ref such as `v1` stands for its commit.
if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1
  fi
  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
  fi
fi

# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)
ASSET_NAME=""
if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
  esac
fi

if [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
else
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
fi
DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"

# The archive runs with job privileges, so it is verified against the release workflow's attestation before extraction.
install_release_asset() {
  if [[ -z "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
    echo "::error::no prebuilt callisto asset exists for $OS_NAME/$ARCH_NAME; install it yourself: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "::error::gh is not available, so the release attestation cannot be verified; install gh or follow: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  # curl retries transient network and HTTP errors itself; a missing asset (404) is not retried.
  if ! curl -sSL -f --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"; then
    rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
    echo "::error::no prebuilt callisto asset $ASSET_NAME for $TAG_NAME could be downloaded; install it yourself: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! gh attestation verify "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" \
      --repo orin-dx/callisto \
      --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
      --deny-self-hosted-runners \
      --source-ref refs/heads/main; then
    rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
    echo "::error::attestation for $ASSET_NAME did not verify; do not use this file: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  # Extract only the expected binary, never the whole archive.
  tar -xzf "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" -C "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" callisto
  echo "Callisto installed from the verified GitHub release ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
}

# Dependencies named callisto-cli do not establish checkout source ownership.
owns_local_source() {
  local workspace git_root metadata
  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1
  git_root=$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
  [[ "$git_root" == "$workspace" ]] || return 1
  git -C "$workspace" ls-files --error-unmatch -- \
    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
    .workspace_root == $workspace and
    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
}

if [[ "$SOURCE" == "local" ]]; then
  if ! owns_local_source; then
    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
else
  install_release_asset
fi

echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
fi

**setup-callisto always verifies the Callisto release**

Workflows from `callisto init` install a binary whose release attestation was verified, in the job that holds publish credentials.

**Breaking:** `setup-callisto` no longer accepts the `verification` input and never falls back to installing from crates.io. It downloads the release archive, runs `gh attestation verify` on it and only then extracts it; a missing platform asset, a failed verification or a missing `gh` fails the step. Remove `verification:` from your workflow. On runners without `gh` or on other CI systems, follow `docs/install-in-ci.md`.

- Why it matters: the job with `id-token: write` and registry credentials only runs a binary that the release workflow attested.
- How to adopt: nothing to change on GitHub-hosted runners, which include `gh`.
- Limits: releases built before the first attested release carry no attestation and cannot be installed by the action.
# Install Callisto in CI

On GitHub-hosted runners, use the `setup-callisto` action. It downloads the release archive, runs `gh attestation verify` on it, and only then extracts the binary. It needs `gh` and has no fallback: if the release has no asset for the platform, the attestation does not verify, or `gh` is missing, the step fails and links here.

Everywhere else (self-hosted runners, other CI systems, containers), follow these steps.

## Verify and install a release

Pick the asset for your platform:

| Platform | Asset |
| --- | --- |
| Linux x86_64 | `callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux x86_64, static (musl) | `callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 | `callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| macOS arm64 | `callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS x86_64 | `callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |

Then download, verify, and extract. Replace `callisto@X.Y.Z` with the release tag, or use `latest/download` for the newest release:

```bash
asset=callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
curl -sSL -f --retry 3 -o "$asset" "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/callisto@X.Y.Z/$asset"
gh attestation verify "$asset" \
  --repo orin-dx/callisto \
  --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
  --deny-self-hosted-runners \
  --source-ref refs/heads/main
tar -xzf "$asset" callisto
```

- Verify before you extract. If `gh attestation verify` fails, delete the archive and do not run it.
- `gh` must be authenticated (`GH_TOKEN`) and recent enough to have `gh attestation verify`.
- Put the extracted `callisto` on `PATH`, outside your workspace so a later `git add -A` cannot stage it.

## Build from source

```bash
cargo install callisto-cli --locked
```

Add `--version X.Y.Z` to pin a release. This builds on the runner and skips attestation, so the crate and its dependencies come from crates.io as `Cargo.lock` resolves them.

## Pin the action by SHA

Reference `setup-callisto` (and `callisto-action`) by commit SHA with the release tag in a comment, for example `uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z`; the action then installs that release.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# A workflow pinned to `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` must install X.Y.Z, not "latest";
# the snippet is extracted by text anchors so the test runs the script's current logic.
set -u
ACTION_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
INSTALL_SCRIPT="$ACTION_DIR/scripts/install-callisto.sh"

extract_snippet() {
  sed -n '/^TAG_NAME="\$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"$/,/^# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries$/p' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT" \
    | sed '$d'
}

# Runs the extracted snippet with INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION/GITHUB_ACTION_REF set
# and `git ls-remote` stubbed to print tag_lines; prints the resulting
# TAG_NAME and records every git invocation.
run_case() {
  local input_version="$1" action_ref="$2" tag_lines="$3" ls_remote_status="${4:-0}"
  local tmp_script calls_file
  tmp_script="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto.XXXXXX")"
  calls_file="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto.XXXXXX")"
  {
    printf 'git() { echo "git $*" >> %q; if [[ "$1 $2" == "ls-remote --tags" ]]; then printf %%s %q; return %q; fi; }\n' \
      "$calls_file" "$tag_lines" "$ls_remote_status"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION=%q\n' "$input_version"
    [[ -n "$action_ref" ]] && printf 'GITHUB_ACTION_REF=%q\n' "$action_ref"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE=auto\n'
    extract_snippet
    printf 'echo "TAG_NAME=$TAG_NAME"\n'
  } > "$tmp_script"
  bash "$tmp_script"
  echo "EXIT=$?"
  echo "---CALLS---"
  cat "$calls_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$calls_file"
}

fail=0
TAGS=$'deadbeef00000000000000000000000000000001\trefs/tags/callisto@0.7.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0^{}\n'

# 1. No action ref set (local/unpinned invocation): stays "latest", no git call.
out=$(run_case "latest" "" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"git ls-remote"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_no_action_ref_stays_latest_without_git_call: $out"; fail=1
else

fi

# 2. Action ref matches a published callisto@ tag: resolved, dereferenced ^{} ignored.
out=$(run_case "latest" "abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_matching_action_ref_resolves_to_tag: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_matching_action_ref_resolves_to_tag"
fi

# 3. Action ref matches no tag: falls back to true latest.
out=$(run_case "latest" "0000000000000000000000000000000000000f" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_unmatched_action_ref_falls_back_to_latest: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_unmatched_action_ref_falls_back_to_latest"
fi

# 3b. A named ref (the floating v1 tag) resolves through the commit it points at, lightweight or annotated.
FLOATING=$'abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/v1\nfeed000000000000000000000000000000000003\trefs/tags/v2\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/v2^{}\n'
out=$(run_case "latest" "v1" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_floating_tag_ref_resolves_to_its_release: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_floating_tag_ref_resolves_to_its_release"
fi
out=$(run_case "latest" "v2" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_annotated_floating_tag_ref_uses_its_peeled_commit: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_annotated_floating_tag_ref_uses_its_peeled_commit"
fi
out=$(run_case "latest" "v9" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_unknown_named_ref_falls_back_to_latest: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_unknown_named_ref_falls_back_to_latest"
fi

# 3c. A failed tag lookup fails the step instead of falling back to latest.
out=$(run_case "latest" "abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002" "" 128)
if [[ "$out" != *"::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002"* \

run_installer() (
  local source="$1" version="$2" checkout="$3" action_ref="${4:-}"
  local fixture code
  fixture=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto-ref.XXXXXX")
  [[ -n "$fixture" && -d "$fixture" ]] || { echo "mktemp -d failed" >&2; exit 1; }
  fixture=$(cd "$fixture" && pwd -P)
  [[ -n "$fixture" && -d "$fixture" ]] || { echo "fixture directory missing" >&2; exit 1; }
  export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$fixture/checkout with spaces" RUNNER_TEMP="$fixture/runner"
  export GITHUB_PATH="$fixture/github-path" GITHUB_ACTION_REF="$action_ref"
  export INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source" INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION="$version"
  mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src" "$RUNNER_TEMP"

  : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs"

          {workspace_root: (if $mode == "foreign-root" then $root + "/other" else $root end),
           workspace_members: (if $mode == "nonmember" then [] else ["cli-id"] end),
           packages: [{id: "cli-id", name: "callisto-cli", source: null,
             manifest_path: (if $mode == "dependency" then "/registry/Cargo.toml"

#[test]
fn red_c3_renamed_tag_template_still_finds_prior_tags() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = dir.path();
    callisto_fixtures::git::init_repo(root);
    fs::write(
        root.join("Cargo.toml"),
        "[workspace]\nmembers = [\"crates/foo\"]\nresolver = \"2\"\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(root.join("crates/foo/src")).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        root.join("crates/foo/Cargo.toml"),
        "[package]\nname = \"foo\"\nversion = \"1.0.0\"\nedition = \"2021\"\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(root.join("crates/foo/src/lib.rs"), "\n").unwrap();
    fs::write(
        root.join("callisto.toml"),
        "[[package]]\nmatch = \"cargo/foo\"\ntag-template = \"bar@{version}\"\nprevious-tag-templates = [\"foo@{version}\"]\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    git(root, &["add", "."]);
    git(root, &["commit", "-m", "initial"]);
    git(root, &["tag", "foo@1.0.0"]);

    let status = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_callisto"))
        .args(["--format", "json", "--cwd", root.to_str().unwrap(), "status"])
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&status.stdout).into_owned();
    assert!(
        status.status.success(),
        "status failed: {}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&status.stderr)
    );
    let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&stdout).unwrap();
    let text = value.to_string();
    let last_released = find_key(&value, "lastReleasedVersion");
    let diagnosed = text.contains("tag-template") || text.contains("tagTemplate");
    assert!(
        last_released.as_deref() == Some("1.0.0") || diagnosed,
        "lastReleasedVersion is {last_released:?} and no diagnostic reports the orphaned tags; status: {stdout}"
    );
}

fn find_key(value: &serde_json::Value, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => map
            .get(key)
            .and_then(|found| found.as_str().map(str::to_owned))
            .or_else(|| map.values().find_map(|inner| find_key(inner, key))),
        serde_json::Value::Array(items) => items.iter().find_map(|item| find_key(item, key)),
        _ => None,
    }
}
